full_judgment: 10. To appreciate the claim and counter claim of the parties, we have gone through the plaint in Title Suit No. 269 of 2017. It appears that, the suit has been filed by the present petitioner, as plaintiff, against the opposite party No. 1 along with others, as defendant, for a decree of permanent injunction representing the Mondir wherein an order of temporary injunction was passed by the trial Court against the present opposite party which was maintained in Miscellaneous Appeal No. 35 of 2018 and the suit is now pending before the court of Senior Assistant Judge, Narayangonj. Present suit has been filed by the opposite party later on, claiming himself to be President of the committee and to that effect he sought for declaration along with other declaration.
